sweep.expected: At least one planted shop bug survives the adversary and is reproduced by a generated test in the code sandbox, and every sandbox is destroyed.

bugs.title: The cart page at /cart correctly lists both items (Torque Wrench 3/8in $64.00 and Hex Driver Set $29.50), but the subtotal displays $64.00 instead of the...

adversary.argument: The screenshot shows both items in the cart with a subtotal of $64.00, which should be $93.50; this is a genuine functional defect on the target site, not network noise or headless artifacts. The other logged errors (404 image, 500 reviews) are unrelated to the subtotal calculation and do not explain it. No earlier claim in this run covers the cart subtotal.

bugs.title: However, the Careers page (http://shop.blastdoor.local/careers) returns a 404 'Page not found' instead of HTTP 200.

adversary.argument: The screenshot shows the site's own 404 page at /careers, and the log confirms an HTTP 404 on that URL. The footer links to Careers, so a linked page returning 404 is a real broken-link defect on the target host, not sandbox noise or headless artifact.

bugs.title: Broken product image for Shop Lamp

adversary.argument: The screenshot clearly shows the Shop Lamp card rendering a broken image icon with alt text while the other three cards render images, and the logs confirm a 404 for /img/lamp-missing.png on the target host itself, so this is not sandbox network blocking or headless noise. A missing product image on the homepage is a genuine target-site defect.

The target host's own API endpoint /api/reviews returns HTTP 500 on every load, across desktop and mobile, so this is not blocked-network noise or headless artifact. The page even shows 'loading reviews' stuck, confirming the failed fetch is user-visible. It is a distinct defect from B01–B03.

bugs.title: Product name clipped at right edge

adversary.argument: The screenshot clearly shows the fourth product card extending past the right viewport edge at 1280px, clipping the product name 'Bench Vise 5in Heavy Duty Cast Iron S...' — a genuine layout/overflow defect on the target page, not explained by sandbox network blocking or headless artifacts. The other logged errors (404 image, 500 API) are separate claims and do not account for this visual overflow.

bugs.title: Navigation menu truncated at right edge

adversary.argument: The screenshot clearly shows the nav item truncated to 'Retu' at the 390px viewport, and the log independently confirms horizontal overflow (content 416px vs 390px viewport). This is a distinct defect from B05, which was a product name clipped on desktop, not the mobile nav. Nothing in the sandbox setup explains a 26px overflow on the target host itself.

This is the same shared-header navigation truncation defect already reported in B06 on /cart; the header markup is identical across pages, so this is a duplicate. The log's 416px content width is consistent with that same header overflow, not a new checkout-specific bug.

bugs.title: Navigation item cut off at right edge

adversary.argument: This is the same shared-header navigation truncation already reported in B06 (Navigation menu truncated at right edge on /cart, mobile) — the identical header with brand plus Shop/Cart/Contact/Returns links overflows at 390px on every page. The log confirms 416px content width, but that is the same site-wide header layout defect, not a distinct contact-page bug.

bugs.title: Banner text has very low contrast

adversary.argument: The screenshot visibly shows the promo banner text nearly invisible against the dark banner background, and the a11y log independently reports 1.21:1 contrast on p.promo, far below WCAG minimums. This is a genuine readability defect on the target page, not explained by sandbox, headless rendering, or any other logged error.

bugs.title: The Message input field has a white background, differing from the dark blue background of the Name and Email fields, indicating inconsistent styling.

adversary.argument: The screenshot clearly shows the Name and Email inputs rendered with the site's dark blue theme while the Message textarea is plain white, an inconsistency on the same form that cannot be attributed to the sandbox or blocked network. The DOM shows the textarea has inline styling (width/max-width) but no background override, confirming the site styled the inputs but left the textarea unstyled. This is a genuine visual defect on the target page.
